title: CI feedback uses only the current PR's runs and never clears its comment from unrelated runs

criteria.given: a green PR run and newer failed or pending runs for another PR on the same SHA
criteria.then: the current PR's feedback stays green and the unrelated run details are not fetched

criteria.given: scheduled or push runs whose REST pull_requests array names the current PR
criteria.then: those non-PR runs do not enter the PR's feedback

criteria.given: a requested PR with no matching pull_request run
criteria.then: the collector leaves PR identity unset and an existing sticky comment is not refreshed
the collector retains commit-wide run selection
